title: Koala reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='8' y='82' width='84' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='8' y='82' width='84' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#A97142'/>
  <!-- koala body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#9AA3AD'/>
  <!-- koala belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#C8CED6'/>
  <!-- koala head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='18' fill='#9AA3AD'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='28' r='9' fill='#9AA3AD'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='28' r='5' fill='#D8B7B0'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='28' r='9' fill='#9AA3AD'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='28' r='5' fill='#D8B7B0'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#C8CED6'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#3B3B4F'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='2' ry='1.2' fill='#6B6B85'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#2E2E44'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#2E2E44'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='39.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57.8' cy='39.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='66' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#9AA3AD'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='66' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#9AA3AD'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <polygon points='38,56 50,60 50,78 38,74' fill='#E8554E'/>
  <polygon points='62,56 50,60 50,78 62,74' fill='#F26B63'/>
  <polygon points='38,56 50,60 50,78 38,74' fill='none'/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <polygon points='40,58 50,61 50,76 40,73' fill='#FFF6E0'/>
  <polygon points='60,58 50,61 50,76 60,73' fill='#FFF6E0'/>
  <!-- text lines on pages -->
  <line x1='42' y1='62' x2='48' y2='64' stroke='#B0B8C4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='66' x2='48' y2='68' stroke='#B0B8C4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='64' x2='58' y2='62' stroke='#B0B8C4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='68' x2='58' y2='66' stroke='#B0B8C4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- paws on book -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='62' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#C8CED6'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='62' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#C8CED6'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='85' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#9AA3AD'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='85' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#9AA3AD'/>
</svg>
